narrative.overview: DocSafe is an institutional judicial and forensic evidentiary platform. The interface balances the solemn procedural gravity of a courtroom record with the uncompromising mathematical precision of distributed cryptographic systems. Visual elements prioritize procedural clarity, auditability, and immediate human comprehension over speculative decoration or futuristic glow.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional Gravitas: Restrained palette grounded in Courtroom Indigo and neutral slates; avoids distracting gradients and cyber-neon styling.
Micro-Data Density: Monospace data blocks formatted for quick visual verification and instant copy-to-clipboard actions.
Unambiguous Semantic Signaling: Rigorous status indicators where each lifecycle stage has a dedicated, universally consistent chromatic identity.
Physical Document Preservation: Authentic document aesthetics for the printable custody certificate that remain clean white paper regardless of active screen theme.

rules.name: The Zero-Glow Rule
rules.body: No decorative neon drop-shadows, blurred glowing borders, or pulsing halos. Visual pop is achieved strictly through crisp 1px borders, subtle surface contrast, and solid badge fills.

rules.name: The Semantic Reserved Rule
rules.body: Crimson is banned for decorative icons or secondary accents; red is reserved exclusively for defective, rejected, or revoked evidentiary states.

rules.name: The Dual-Identity Rule
rules.body: Monospace hashes and hexadecimal addresses must never float without an accompanying human-readable semantic label.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are planar at rest. Shadow elevation is never used as pure ornamentation and appears only to indicate elevated interaction.

dos: Do always pair cryptographic hashes (SHA-256, IPFS CID, Tx Hashes) with clickable copy-to-clipboard affordances.
Do display both the human-readable case number and title alongside numeric document IDs.
Do maintain a strict 1px border around cards and inputs in both light and dark modes to preserve crisp structural contrast.
Do preserve authentic light paper styling on the Chain-of-Custody Certificate so legal printouts remain clean and official.
Do provide immediate inline transaction state feedback.
donts: Don't use neon glowing box-shadows, scanlines, or decorative futuristic sci-fi tropes.
Don't use red accents for non-destructive actions, neutral indicators, or decorative buttons.
Don't render cryptographic hashes in proportional sans-serif fonts; always use standard monospace.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate verification status; always pair with an explicit textual status label.
Don't allow long cryptographic strings to overflow mobile viewports; enforce break-all or truncate with copy tooltips.
